Ads will be launching soon on Apple Maps in the US and Canada, and businesses can start booking ads from today. Here's the details, including a limited-time promotional offer.

Businesses can start booking Apple Maps ads from today

If you own a business and want to advertise through Apple Maps, the booking service is officially launched today.

Although users have not yet seen ads officially go live, Apple is preparing for a full rollout and is now allowing businesses to start booking ads.

Apple's website has already published complete information about ad bookings, including details on how to get started.

Apple is also offering a special limited-time promotional offer, with details as follows:

This offer is available to eligible businesses that book map ads with credit card payment on or before October 11, 2026.

As mentioned earlier this year, ads will appear in two locations within Apple Maps:

  • Before users search: Sponsored business information will appear in the "Suggested Places" section of the search page.
  • After users search: When search results are relevant to the search terms, ads will be displayed within the results.

If you're considering advertising on Apple Maps, Apple also has a dedicated webpage explaining their advertising policies; click here for details.

Apple says Apple Maps receives over 1 billion business-related searches per month, and one out of every two business searches leads to user action. In addition, according to the first quarter 2025 GWI Core Study, Gen Z and Millennials make up 57% of Apple Maps users.
